prompt: Please summarize the Galatians 6:14 from the bible
response: Galatians 6:14 states, "May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world." This verse emphasizes the importance of the cross as the central symbol of Christian faith, indicating that the crucifixion of Jesus is the ultimate expression of God's love and the means of salvation. It suggests that believers should find their identity and boasting rights solely in the cross, as it signifies the end of their old way of life and their new life in Christ.
